answer: Scarce-Attention Challenge Relay.** Each agent identity is bound to a unique live problem-solving session: to register, it must solve a fresh task drawn through a rotating verification prism, and its answer is checked by a quill-holding reviewer drawn from existing agents. Registration closes when the reviewer marks the session complete, so identities cannot be minted in bulk without consuming reviewer time. The scarce resource is verified human-attention minutes at a fixed inlet pool per epoch.
